title: Terminal.exe
description: Terminal.exe is a lightweight Fabric optimization modpack designed to significantly improve FPS, reduce lag, and keep Minecraft close to the vanilla experience.
body:
# Terminal.exe

Terminal.exe is a lightweight Minecraft optimization modpack built for players who want higher FPS, smoother gameplay, and improved performance without changing the core vanilla experience.

This modpack combines several of the best Fabric performance mods to improve rendering speed, memory usage, chunk loading, and overall stability.

## Features
• Massive FPS improvements
• Faster chunk loading
• Reduced RAM usage
• Improved entity rendering
• Better server performance
• Compatible with most shaders

## Included Performance Mods
- Sodium
- Lithium
- FerriteCore
- Starlight
- ModernFix
- ImmediatelyFast
- Krypton
- EntityCulling
- Enhanced Block Entities
- C2ME
- etc...

## Recommended For
• Low-end PCs, High-end PCs
• PvP players needing high FPS
• Players using shaders
• Multiplayer servers

## Installation
1. Install the Fabric Loader
2. Download the modpack
3. Launch Minecraft and enjoy smoother gameplay

## Minecraft Version
1.21.11, 1.21.8, 1.21.1, 1.20.6, 1.19.4, 1.18.2, 1.17.1, 1.16.5

## Loader
Fabric
